An all-in-one AI sales platform: an AI 'Searcher' that turns a plain-English ICP into verified contacts, 100+ contact-level buying-intent signals, and social prospecting from LinkedIn, plus multichannel outreach and deliverability tooling — drawing on a large multi-source contact database it refreshes continuously. Its Duo copilot proactively surfaces prioritized leads from 20+ real-time signal types, and an MCP server puts the platform inside ChatGPT or Claude — where it can triage the Unibox, update or remove leads, and since July run a whole account-based play end to end: research the account, pull enriched profiles, and enrol every contact into one sequence with copy written per person and per step, without leaving the chat, and a GTM Skills Library opens the rest of the platform along the same route. Duo Voice is the audio arm of the same copilot: you read one short sample aloud, it clones your voice, and a voice-message step can then be dropped into any sequence, with the message written per prospect from their data and adapted to their language — LinkedIn voice notes rather than another block of text. Since June you can also describe a workflow in plain English and have it built for you in the normal editor, and meeting notes from Fathom and Attention flow into the activity feed. Deliverability is a named toolkit rather than a footnote: a Domain Health Center for SPF/DKIM/DMARC, inbox-to-outbox ratio, spam-list and mailbox-age monitoring; automated warm-up and recovery for flagged Gmail or Outlook mailboxes; weekly spam-placement tests before a campaign goes out; and Duo rotating the sending mailbox per email against that same health data. Workflows, the automation layer, is included for every customer rather than sold as a premium add-on: triggers (a sequence finishing with no reply, a bounce, a meeting booked, a call logged, a CRM field changing), filters for who qualifies, branching paths and actions (enrol in another sequence, update CRM fields, create tasks, manage lists, enrich, add to exclusion lists), assembled on a visual canvas so the whole logic is readable at a glance. Twenty ready-made Recipes cover lead routing, keeping non-responders warm, account plays, CRM hygiene and do-not-contact enforcement. It runs against Salesforce and HubSpot out of the box, and without a CRM connected the triggers and actions that don't depend on one still work. The browser extension carries the same work into whatever page you are on: adding and editing notes, creating and running tasks, and filtering the activity feed without switching tabs.

Best forMid-market sales teams (20+ reps) who'll actually adopt the full AI-prospecting, multichannel and deliverability stack in one vendor.
